description: Vitest-only onTestFinished and onTestFailed, global and on the test context, registered three at a time on a passing test and on failing tests (one nested under a describe with its own hooks). onTestFinished runs after afterEach and the beforeEach teardowns, in reverse registration order; onTestFailed runs only for failures, after onTestFinished, and follows sequence.hooks order. Both receive the test context.
